segments.title: Cuba Talks, Pam Bondi, and Crum's Legal Woes
segments.notes: Case Blackwell anchors coverage of Marco Rubio blocking Trump-Cuba negotiations, Pam Bondi's Epstein hearing testimony, and Crum's emerging legal trouble with urine-stock app Pino Y.

segments.title: Rave Dancing, Cookie Dough, and Jaw-Based Self-Defense
segments.notes: Jeb Nogget teaches rave dance moves (stomp, block the apple, milk kiss), bakes a tub of cookie dough, and demonstrates self-defense using only his jaw and 'steam roller' technique.

segments.title: AI Video, Bad Bunny, and Kendall's Ballet Sneakers
segments.notes: Rick hosts viral video review covering Sea Dance 2.0 AI clips, Bad Bunny Super Bowl translation, and a surprise visit from Kendall and her brother Jiggy showing off Taekwondo shoes.

segments.title: Mustache Rides, Atari Age Terrorism, and Wolf Romance
segments.notes: Trip Bradstein interviews park visitors including a mustache-ride enthusiast, a gack-waterboarded Atari Age infiltrator, a three-mouthed hair-cutting entity, and a lovestruck wolf named Jack Turtle.

segments.title: Burncycle Speedrun Interrupted by Mom and Brick Lizard
segments.notes: Brandon struggles through the spy game Burncycle while his mother harasses him about sandwiches, KY jelly, and Pastor Joe, and Brick Lizard loops 'Snake Eater' lyrics over the gameplay.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchored main news desk covering Cuba/Rubio, Pam Bondi/Epstein, and chat news; hosted Amongst the Web with Rick.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivered cold open station sign-on as 'Papita the dog'; managed proprietary donation bar logic (300 bits = 1 sub).

characters.notes: debate analyst. Briefly appeared seeking crowdfunding for legal defense against Pino Y urine-stock app, claiming 'penis in his eye' trouble.

characters.notes: hype train. Derailed bits acknowledgment into Sibian rap freestyle about 'pussy getting wet' and brown shaking.

characters.notes: instructional host. Taught rave dancing, baked cookie dough, and demonstrated jaw-based gun disarms with deceased father's board heckling.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Appeared during Amongst the Web with brother Jiggy to model Taekwondo 'ballet sneakers' and defend them against chat.

characters.name: Trip Bradstein
characters.notes: field correspondent. Conducted park interviews including mustache-ride proposal, Atari Age terrorist, hair-cutting entity, and wolf romance.

characters.name: Brandon (CryptoZeu$)
characters.notes: gaming correspondent. Played Burncycle while mother interrupted with sandwich demands, KY jokes, and Pastor Joe references; Brick Lizard haunted audio.

storylines.beat: Crum references new legal trouble with Pino Y app ('penis in his eye') and solicits Crum Legal Defense Fund, distinct from resolved gorilla wager.

lore_notes.fact: Entangled in legal trouble with Pino Y, a urine-color stock advice app; claims 'penis in his eye' / 'P-N-U-I' incident; soliciting Crum Legal Defense Fund via bits/subs.
Developed proprietary donation bar where 300 bits equals one sub equivalent; plans independent donation button to bypass Twitch/Amazon.
Father's spirit remains trapped in wooden board; Jeb demonstrates self-defense using only jaw strength and 'steam roller' move.
Visited studio with brother Jiggy (Justin) to model Adidas Taekwondo shoes ('ballet sneakers'); threatened chat over criticism.
Has not used bathroom in six days; maintains Wednesday 8pm-4am 'bathroom block' strapped into corner box; mother calls him 'Bran Bran'.
References stalker 'Goose' (male) and former mod 'X Crane' locked up for years over sponsorship deal; Pastor Joe brings Happy Meals.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell opened with Cuba diplomacy chaos and Pam Bondi's combative Epstein hearing, while Crum diverted the Crum Legal Defense Fund toward a urine-stock app lawsuit. Jeb Nogget taught rave stomps and jaw-based gun disarms, Rick and Case reviewed AI video breakthroughs and Bad Bunny lyrics alongside Kendall's Taekwondo shoe debut, Trip Bradstein collected park opinions from a mustache-ride enthusiast and a gack-waterboarded Atari Age terrorist, and Brandon nearly broke mentally grinding Burncycle under maternal siege and Brick Lizard's Snake Eater loop.
